definitions.explanation: An approximate calculation of the cost, quantity, or time required for something, often provided before work begins.

examples.japanese: {見積|みつも}もり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見積|みつも}もり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got an estimate for the repair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見積|みつも}もり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The construction estimate greatly exceeded the budget.

notes:
{見積|みつも}もり refers to a preliminary calculation of cost, time, or quantity, typically provided before work begins. Very common in business contexts for price quotations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見積|みつも}もり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get an estimate (from a company)
- {見積|みつも}もり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to provide an estimate
- {見積|みつも}もり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to request an estimate
- {見積|みつも}もり⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: written estimate, quotation document
- {見積|みつも}もり⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: estimated amount

USAGE:
In business, it is standard practice to request a {見積|みつも}もり before committing to a purchase or service. The expression {見積|みつも}もり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ ("Is the estimate free?") is very common.
